content.hardestProblem: Letting twelve product verticals share one trust and checkout core while each keeps its own data model, and having CI fail the build when a vertical reaches across that boundary rather than relying on review to catch it.
limitations: No public source, live deployment, or case study yet, so nothing on this page can be independently inspected.
The AI features have automated tests but no published evaluation set, so translation and visual-search quality are unmeasured.
Vertical isolation is enforced in CI but the enforcement itself has no published failure report.
content.problem: Cross-border B2B trade spans verticals with incompatible catalogue shapes, but buyers and sellers need one identity, one trust model, and one checkout across all of them.

responsibilities: AI feature implementation behind a swappable provider layer

summary: A cross-border B2B trade marketplace whose plugin architecture lets twelve product verticals share a common trust and checkout core while owning isolated data models, with the boundaries enforced automatically in CI.
tagline: Twelve product verticals sharing one trust and checkout core, with data-model isolation enforced in CI.
title: Cross-Border B2B Trade Marketplace
